## **Somatic SNV/Indel** {#snv-indel}

```{r somatic_mut_maf}
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

coding_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Nonstop_Mutation"
)

maf <- readr::read_tsv(params$somatic_mut_maf, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE)

maf_tbl <- maf %>%
  dplyr::filter(Variant_Classification %in% coding_classes) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    caller_n = stringr::str_count(caller,',') + 1,
    VAF = t_vaf,
    Depth = t_depth,
    Position = paste0(Chromosome, ":", Start_Position),
    Variant = coalesce(HGVSp_Short, HGVSc, Variant_Classification),
    Effect = stringr::str_replace_all(Variant_Classification, "_", " ")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Gene = Hugo_Symbol,
    Variant,
    Effect,
    Position,
    Ref = Reference_Allele,
    Alt = Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
    VAF,
    Depth,
    Alt_count = t_alt_count,
    Caller = caller,
    Caller_n = caller_n
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(Caller_n),
    dplyr::desc(VAF)
  )

caller_badge <- function(caller, caller_n) {
  if (is.na(caller) || caller == "") return("")
  
  bg <- dplyr::case_when(
    caller_n >= 3 ~ "#16a34a",
    caller_n == 2 ~ "#2563eb",
    caller_n == 1 ~ "#ea580c",
    TRUE ~ "#64748b"
  )
  
  span(
    title = paste0("Detected by: ", caller, "\nNumber of callers: ", caller_n),
    style = paste0(
      "display:inline-block;",
      "padding:3px 9px;",
      "border-radius:999px;",
      "font-size:12px;",
      "font-weight:700;",
      "color:white;",
      "background:", bg, ";",
      "cursor:help;"
    ),
    paste0(caller_n, " caller", ifelse(caller_n > 1, "s", ""))
  )
}

effect_badge <- function(effect) {
  bg <- dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(effect, "Nonsense|Frame Shift|Splice") ~ "#dc2626",
    stringr::str_detect(effect, "Missense|In Frame") ~ "#2563eb",
    stringr::str_detect(effect, "Silent|Synonymous") ~ "#64748b",
    TRUE ~ "#475569"
  )
  
  span(
    style = paste0(
      "display:inline-block;",
      "padding:3px 8px;",
      "border-radius:6px;",
      "font-size:12px;",
      "font-weight:600;",
      "color:white;",
      "background:", bg, ";"
    ),
    effect
  )
}

vaf_bar <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value)) return("")
  
  pct <- value * 100
  div(
    style = "display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;",
    div(
      style = "
        width:90px;
        height:9px;
        background:#e5e7eb;
        border-radius:999px;
        overflow:hidden;
      ",
      div(
        style = paste0(
          "height:100%;",
          "width:", max(0, min(pct, 100)), "%;",
          "background:#1e3a8a;",
          "border-radius:999px;"
        )
      )
    ),
    span(sprintf("%.1f%%", pct))
  )
}
div(
  style = "
    width: 90%;
    margin: 20px auto;
  ",
reactable(
  maf_tbl,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  defaultSorted = list(
    Caller_n = "desc",
    VAF = "desc"
  ),
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  compact = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  columns = list(
    Gene = colDef(
      minWidth = 90,
      style = list(
        fontStyle = "italic",
        fontWeight = "700"
      )
    ),
    Variant = colDef(
      minWidth = 120,
      cell = function(value) {
        span(
          title = value,
          style = "
            font-weight:700;
            white-space:nowrap;
            overflow:hidden;
            text-overflow:ellipsis;
            display:inline-block;
            max-width:160px;
            cursor:help;
          ",
          value
        )
      }
    ),
    Effect = colDef(
      minWidth = 150,
      cell = effect_badge
    ),
    Position = colDef(minWidth = 140),
    Ref = colDef(maxWidth = 70),
    Alt = colDef(maxWidth = 70),
    VAF = colDef(
      minWidth = 150,
      cell = vaf_bar
    ),
    Depth = colDef(maxWidth = 80, align = "right"),
    Alt_count = colDef(name = "Alt reads", maxWidth = 90, align = "right"),
    Caller = colDef(
      show = FALSE
    ),
    Caller_n = colDef(
      name = "Caller support",
      minWidth = 130,
      cell = function(value, index) {
        caller_badge(maf_tbl$Caller[index], value)
      }
    )
  ),
  theme = reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#e5e7eb",
    stripedColor = "#f8fafc",
    highlightColor = "#eef6ff",
    cellPadding = "8px 10px",
    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "13px"
    ),
    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#0f5a2e",
      color = "white",
      fontWeight = "700"
    )
  )
),
)
```
